npcs.name: Gate Guard
npcs.title: Colosseum Gate
npcs.line: The arena is open to all challengers. Step through the gate when you're ready.

npcs.name: Town Crier
npcs.title: News
npcs.line: Hear ye! Fresh blood on the ladder, and the Champion has not been beaten in a season!

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.title: Fruit seller
npcs.line: Apples, figs, a little luck! Best you'll find outside the walls.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.title: Traveller
npcs.line: They say the road south leads to the old forest. I'm waiting on my escort.

npcs.name: Harbour Warden
npcs.title: Ferry Landing
npcs.line: The ferry to Paradise Island leaves from the end of the road. A quiet place to rest between bouts.

actions.text: Oh! Excuse me. I dropped my mother's locket somewhere on the road in from the harbour, and my escort is late again.
It is silver, with a blue stone. If you find it, I would be so grateful.
My locket... somewhere on the road in from the harbour, I think.
That is it! Mother's locket. Take this, please. It is all I carry, but it is yours.
Mara's gift
Psst. See the knight standing by the road? He was a Colosseum prisoner. Broke his chains and now he smashes my fruit stand every night.
Teach him a lesson, and I'll pay you what the stand earns in a month.
He lurks by the road to the harbour. Watch your back, he hits like a cart.
You did it! Not one apple bruised! Here, you earned every coin.
Pip's reward
You'll not drag me back to the pit! I have nothing left to lose!
A hundred gold a throw, high roll takes the pot. Ties give your coin back.
Four hundred a throw. Come to lose it, or come to win it.
BOUT SCHEDULE: Recruit bouts at dawn. The Unbroken Pair will face any who clear Rank 2.
Mercenaries wanted. Apply at the Summoning Circle, inside.
A silver locket with a blue stone, half buried in the road dust.
SIDE BOUNTIES (Paradise Island and the road):
- Pua the fisher lost a net in the Whispering Wood.
- Old Tane has a goblin brute smashing his fence.
- Scholar Nema wants three glyph pages.
- Mara lost a locket on the harbour road.
- Pip wants the runaway knight dealt with.
